subject.title: #92561: fix(security): bound context file ancestor walk to workspace root

question: For callers that do not pass workspaceDir, should context-file loading fail closed at cwd, or should OpenClaw preserve ancestor loading through a resolved workspace root supplied by production callers?
rationale: The secure default and the upgrade-compatible default are in tension, and the PR currently changes public SDK/resource-loader behavior while fixing a security boundary.

options.title: Require real workspace boundary
options.body: Update production session callers to pass a canonical workspace root and keep omitted workspaceDir behavior explicitly tested and documented before merge.

options.title: Accept cwd fail-closed fallback
options.body: Land the stricter omitted-workspaceDir default with maintainer-visible release-note/API upgrade proof that parent context files will no longer load for those callers.

options.title: Pause for context policy
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader directory-context policy in the related feature discussion defines defaults, ordering, and compatibility behavior.

recommendation.title: Require real workspace boundary
recommendation.body: Update production session callers to pass a canonical workspace root and keep omitted workspaceDir behavior explicitly tested and documented before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The session resource-loader and public session API path were introduced and recently documented through commits associated with steipete.
